   **Bugs and stability.**
      16 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Aug 8, 2026 - Nov 3, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Jahi120_, Nov 2, 2026, 1/5: "The app has known bugs that they have not been able to fix, but they are still selling it. I cannot get a refund despite a non functioning app. Buyer beware"
            2. _Anatanotenshi_, Oct 15, 2026, 1/5: "Very disappointed with what the application has become. Before, it worked very well, it blocked requested applications after the requested time and unblocked them after the requested time. Now it no longer blocks. I can spend hours on an application with a 15min block without ever seeing the block. Sometimes I spend 2 minutes there and I'm blocked, and when I want to unblock my application for 15 minutes it blocks immediately without the 15 minute delay, multiple times, which means that I have to return to the page several times to unblock my application without success. Suddenly my fingers learned the automatic path to unlock time, which became useless because what prevented me from unlocking time were these movements and this extra time needed to unlock the application, and because of these bugs it became automatic. And just as unbearable, the blocking time is sometimes 3 times longer than requested for no reason. This app was great and did its job very well. Now it's just become useless scenery at best and actively distracting at worst, and it no longer serves its purpose at all. Very disappointed with what she has become."
            3. _Tomito6_, Oct 2, 2026, 1/5: "I payed this app for almost a year. Not worth it at all! I found a much better app that was not 20€ per month. And let me tell you that this app also often didn’t work. It’s super buggy!! For some reason my instagram always seemed to unlock between 23-24 (even if I put a lot of extra rules or changed stuff) it also often didn’t revognize time limits so it’s quite literally not doing it’s only purpose, while demanding 20€. Hoooorrrribble app. Migrated to a new one and wish I could go back in time to avoid this scam"
